history.summary: Newly completed (2024) 1BR in D05 at $958k and $1,589 PSF, a steep discount to the $1,972 development median — but the appreciation rate is new-launch-biased and weak (1.2-1.9%/yr), as expected for a project still digesting its launch premium. Sub-$1M near One-North with upside if it converges to median.
history.rating_rationale: The $1,589 PSF vs $1,972 median looks like a ~19% discount, but the project just TOP'd in 2024 so early resale prints are noisy and the rate carries new-launch bias (system already flags it). 161 txns give decent volume but the early-cycle data understates the eventual stabilized rate. Sub-$1M, 99LH 1BR near Pasir Panjang/One-North has steady rental support. Greater Southern Waterfront is a long-dated catalyst. A fair hold; the median gap is the upside, the weak/biased rate and 1BR niche are the brakes.

history.summary: Genuinely under-priced 1BR in a quality 2024 Oxley project in OCR-fringe D5 — asking $1,589 psf sits at the very bottom of the project range and ~18% below the verified 1BR average of ~$1,941 psf.
history.rating_rationale: The algo's cheapness is corroborated by the web: 1BR units here average ~$1,941 psf with a project range of $1,575-$2,310, and recent 2025 1BR resales printed $1,929-$2,039 psf, yet this unit asks only $1,588.72 psf ($958k). That is a real ~18% discount to its own size cohort (dossier psf_premium_vs_cohort -20.3% across 27 txns — a respectable, non-thin cohort), not a one-comparable quirk. age_adj_premium of -23.1% is the strongest robust value signal here and it holds up. D5 (Pasir Panjang) is OCR-fringe where realized forward returns are stronger (~+4%) than CCR, supporting the v3.4 region prior. Developer Oxley has no major defect history and the project won architectural awards (2024 TOP, fresh lease). I discount the low trailing appreciation_pct of 1.91% as near-meaningless (new project, ~0 forward power per backtest). Main caveats: 99-yr lease, Oxley is a high-gearing developer, and 603 sqft 1BR is a thinner exit segment. Not Strong Buy because the discount may partly reflect a less desirable stack/facing I cannot verify, but the value case is solid.
red_flags: 99-year leasehold (lease just started 2024 — full term but no FH premium)
Oxley Holdings carries high gearing / large unsold inventory; balance-sheet developer risk
603 sqft 1BR is a smaller exit segment; verify the discount isn't a poor stack/low floor/west-facing penalty
catalysts: Asking ~18% below verified 1BR average ($1,589 vs ~$1,941 psf) — immediate value gap if stack/facing is acceptable
OCR-fringe D5 (Pasir Panjang / one-north / Kent Ridge / NUS) — stronger realized forward returns than CCR, employment + research-hub rental demand
Fresh 2024 lease and award-winning design support resale/rental appeal
